svg.title: ORB | First confirmation did not survive a separate second block
svg.desc: Frozen USTEC2 medoid; independently spent blocks. OOS-A: 2025 signals, Jan 2026 burnoff. OOS-B: Feb–Jun 2026 signals, Jul burnoff. Month-end aggregates from verified original exit timestamps and returns; no mark-to-market equity or within-month path is implied. Separate horizontal scales reflect different horizons. The second block failed its standalone primary and region gates; no pooled rescue.
